name: ECC
description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
one_liner: A toolkit that gives AI coding assistants better memory, built-in security checks, and ready-made skills, so they make fewer mistakes across whatever AI tool you use.
buyer: An engineering lead running Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools across a team who wants consistent guardrails and automated security review without building it in-house.
business_use_cases: An engineering team installs the companion GitHub App for automated security review on every AI-assisted pull request instead of hiring a dedicated reviewer.
A dev agency standardizes every client project on this harness so all AI agents follow the same memory and skill conventions regardless of client.
A security-conscious fintech buys the private-repo tier to get the agent-security protections without exposing proprietary code to a free public service.

money_ideas.idea: The project already sells paid 'ECC Pro' seats for private-repo use through a GitHub App — a template for bundling AI-agent guardrails as a subscription add-on.

steal_this: Install the free GitHub App on one of your own repos this weekend to see the automated agent-security review in action before recommending it to a client.
